'''Kkatamik''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who sought to spread the ideals of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]].

==Biography==
For the Life Day festivities of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Kkatamik traveled to [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], [[Vreni Island]] and the island [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]] to teach [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] about Life Day.

He sent a number of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to visit [[Oraalarri]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] and [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], so that they could learn more about the festival.

==Behind the scenes==
Kkatamik was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. During the Life Day event of [[2004]], players could talk to Kkatamik in either Anchorhead, Vreni Island or the Lake Retreat. Kkatamik would then send the player to visit a Wookiee family on either Endor or Yavin 4, where they could learn more about Life Day and receive a gift.
